title: Oozy Citrusy Greek Chicken Avgolemono
description: A citrusy and indulgent Greek dish featuring chicken, light rum, and a soffritto base, this recipe is a satvik-friendly take on the traditional avgolemono.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the light rum, lemon juice, chicken broth, salt, and black pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks.
Gradually add the hot chicken broth to the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Stir the egg yolk mixture into the saucepan and cook for 2 minutes.
Serve the chicken and sauce hot.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
